newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore to double infrastructure spending.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to double infrastructure spending.

text.p: Singapore will double expenditure on economic and infrastructural development in fiscal 1997 to Singapore $4.0 billion from S$2.0 billion in fiscal 1996, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.
Hu said in his budget speech that economic and infrastructural development was expected to take 41 percent of total development expenditure.

"While funding on social and community services continues to increase, development expenditure on economic and infrastructural development is set to double from S$2 billion in FY96 to S$4 billion in FY97," he said.
This would exceed the share of social and community services which took the biggest share in past years.
